reason: I already have my regular electrician and a parlour girl I call on WhatsApp, both people I trust after years -- I don't see why I'd download a new app and gamble on a stranger with barely any ratings near me just because the commission is lower.
objection: You're saying the pool of verified pros near me is still small while you 'onboard the first batch' -- so if I actually need someone this week, there may be nobody good available, and I've wasted time on an app for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If my own regular electrician or parlour actually joined hithozha with good ratings, or if a neighbour I trust in Coimbatore used it and vouched for it working smoothly, I might try it once.
